name: The Launch at Hingham Shipyard
summary: The Launch at Hingham Shipyard is a waterfront lifestyle center featuring fitness studios, entertainment venues, and dining options in a scenic South Shore location. This open-air destination combines experiential retail with harbor views, anchored by Club Pilates, Sweathouz, and Patriot Cinemas.
demographics: The Launch at Hingham Shipyard attracts an affluent, family-oriented demographic from the South Shore Boston suburbs, with visitors typically in the 30-55 age range and above-average household incomes exceeding $100,000. The trade area draws from Hingham's well-educated professional population and surrounding coastal communities, with shoppers seeking convenient access to fitness, dining, and entertainment options. The center appeals to health-conscious consumers and families looking for experiential retail combined with lifestyle amenities, reflecting the upscale residential character of the South Shore market.
description: The Launch at Hingham Shipyard is a vibrant waterfront lifestyle destination located in the historic Hingham Shipyard district along Boston's South Shore. This open-air shopping and entertainment center combines fitness, dining, and leisure experiences in a scenic harborside setting at 18 Shipyard Drive. Featured tenants include Club Pilates for boutique fitness enthusiasts, Sweathouz offering innovative wellness experiences, and Patriot Cinemas providing state-of-the-art movie entertainment for the whole family. The center's waterfront location and carefully curated mix of experiential retailers create a unique gathering place that goes beyond traditional shopping. With convenient access from Route 3 and proximity to the Hingham Ferry, The Launch serves as a premier lifestyle destination for South Shore residents and visitors seeking quality entertainment, fitness, and dining options in a picturesque New England harbor setting.
